dedupe_keys.name: data olahan energi emisi karbon dan penggunaan lahan data center indonesia 2024 2034

description: This Indonesian workbook compiles secondary figures and illustrative projections for data-centre energy, carbon emissions and land use in Indonesia from 2024 to 2034. Zenodo provides an open Excel file and a public text README under CC BY 4.0. The README describes sheets for source metadata, energy projections, facility electricity cases, energy-mix emission factors and land-use cases. A modeller could use the documented assumptions as scenario inputs for regional grid demand or land-use studies. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Its source list includes official planning material and published analyses, but the sheets are a student-assembled compilation, not measurements at individual facilities. The carbon calculation assumes a constant electricity emission factor for an illustrative estimate. Coverage and years vary with the upstream sources. The workbook was not downloaded, and its individual cells, formulas and source licences were not independently checked.
